answer: Exit must hurt: deregistering burns 50% of escrowed stake, and re-entry restarts a 14-epoch maturation at zero weight, so sybil operators cannot wash taint by rotating burnt identities. Forging N fakes locks 2,000 tokens each; each wash halves the principal - five leave 3%, like saffron fading after brews. The honest agent pays once; the juniper hedge of seasoned identities outgrows saplings. Burn history prisms re-entries from the same bankroll.
